review_scope: 9 new files, 481 visually inspected sampled timestamps; 8 usable sources; no full audio transcription.

findings.observation: 609 observations reported; integer deltas -8..11 with a near-uniform central -6..8 band. Movement excludes changing floors.
findings.correction: Observed API accepts every integer -8..11, instead of just -6 or +8. Default missing observations stay unresolved.
findings.prior: Explicit experiment only: central integers uniform; independent per-instance draws. Main tail mass 0; sensitivity .0066 with uniform tail allocation. Neither is a verified server law.
findings.supersedes: rogue6_xianshu9_video_audit_v1 XS9-WAVE and the endpoint interpretation in economy-catalog-audit-2026-09-08.md
findings.conflict: Displayed tail .66% versus a subtitle comparing the five rare outcomes to the former at1/39. If interpreted per-value, this implies5/(15*39+5)=.84746%, not .66%; the antecedent is ambiguous. Raw data unavailable.

findings.observation: Holding time and variance matter; take useful incidental movement opportunities; liquidate when appraisal is valuable and cash is needed.
findings.implementation: Expected bounded appraisal uses current value and public movement horizon; liquidity and inventory constraints remain. No bonus for unspendable terminal paper growth.

findings.observation: Early key income and capacity support natural goods, concepts and mobility; early combat strength supports growth. Self-reported results are not model calibration.
findings.implementation: Retain existing capacity and liquidity constraints; wave valuation now competes for that capacity. No unconditional combat multiplier or new cash grant.

findings.observation: Attack-speed concepts and shield/tree synergy described; not an isolated observed battle trigger.
Starting capital/capacity and competition ticket restrictions discussed.
findings.implementation: Does not override user-confirmed project scope and ticket-retention rules.

findings.observation: No universal best floor: weigh experience against emergency rewards and early access to Advance. Commentary says autopsy has no part drop.
findings.implementation: No base reward change from this clip; battle in background is a different stage.

findings.observation: Video explains four independent positions; two chest and two tree opportunities.
findings.implementation: Retain parsed two mutually-exclusive random groups with weights 850/105/35/35/15, total1040. Video cannot establish independence; register conflict rather than invent new distribution.

findings.observation: Civilization floor rates, portal contents, conditional page results and shop stock timing discussed.
findings.implementation: No frequency overwrite or guaranteed reward derived from these summaries.

findings.observation: 43 ordinary map templates; counts 4b/4g35,4i28,5c43,5d36. Large templates add many empty nodes; counting conventions and graph distance matter.
findings.implementation: Template library has 3+10+10+10+10=43. Listed counts match occupied slots minus start. Keep existing 26 source-rule conflicts; tiny distance table not legible enough to adjudicate.
findings.reward_caution: 47XP autopsy example explicitly has an XP bonus; do not use as base XP.

findings.observation: Repeated natural-goods liquidation and replacement of movement items; later green-shop conversion. Bank balance, current cash, physical inventory and total obtained items are distinct.
findings.implementation: Supports conditional liquidity hypothesis. No claim of exact return attribution from minute-spaced frames.
